prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: completely new homepage hero illustration for OsakaPNG, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: irresistibly cute Takopen mascot taking a little stroll through Osaka. Reimagine the artwork from the ground up as a soft, charming miniature world with a plush character.
Input: The supplied image is ONLY a reference for the identity of Takopen, the mascot above the OsakaPNG wordmark. Ignore all lettering and do not reproduce the wordmark.
Art direction: a beautifully art-directed tiny Osaka model village, rounded matte clay architecture and a soft short-pile plush Takopen. Tender contemporary Japanese character-goods aesthetic, soothing, airy and warm. Convincing gentle fabric pile on the mascot, tactile rounded edges, soft diffuse daylight and subtle contact shadows. Background architecture has smooth pastel clay surfaces. High-end cute toy photography style, never a flat poster.
Takopen identity: a squat, very round pale butter-cream penguin combined with a takoyaki ball, tiny purple dot eyes placed low and wide, a small orange oval beak, two tiny orange webbed feet, very short flippers; brown takoyaki sauce patch on top with soft wavy edge and a few tiny green aonori flecks; one little rounded orange-and-purple takoyaki pick emerging diagonally at upper-right of its head. Keep these recognizable features from the reference. Subtle soft pink cheeks make the expression friendly. No heavy outline: purple can appear in small sewn details and the pick. Body visibly wider than tall, one continuous soft round body, no elongated torso. No separate human head or neck, no human hands, no black-and-white penguin.
Scene: One small, lovable full-body Takopen in the foreground, taking a tiny waddling step and holding a little simple folded pastel sightseeing map. A tiny lavender side satchel is enough; keep its body clean and readable. Miniature Osaka surrounds it: a gentle curved canal and low arched footbridge, two or three tiny cheerful canal-side storefronts, a small Tsutenkaku-inspired observation tower and an Osaka Castle-inspired roof cluster behind. One storefront can have a tiny simple generic game-controller pictogram to nod to the gaming team. This feels like a delightful Osaka walk, a miniature travel memory.
Composition: Takopen is the visual focus but only about 40-45 percent of the image height, centered in the lower middle, its entire body and pick visible. The Osaka village frames it gently in the middle third, with generous uncluttered warm ivory negative space around the scene. Essential contents all inside central 65 percent width, because website desktop crops may approach 1.2:1. No objects right at edges. The canal and path give a subtle winding movement. Three-quarter eye-level toy view, no giant looming mascot. All elements sit naturally on the same lightly colored ground plane; no pedestal, no floating island.
Palette: warm ivory background #faf8f2, butter yellow character, muted lilac-purple accents #9b81bd, mint water #bfe4d5, peach and apricot small roofs. Brown sauce and orange beak retained. Rich purple accents used sparingly. Gentle low contrast, clear shapes.
Absolutely avoid: dramatic sunset, yellow sky, grunge, halftone, ink splatter, thick purple cartoon outlines, dark city silhouettes, realistic buildings, busy detail, large black camera, oversized limbs or beak, giant controller, shiny plastic, hard chrome, aggressive esports styling, balloons, orbit rings, planets, bubbles, circular badge framing, any text, Japanese characters, wordmarks, watermarks. No other characters or extra copies of Takopen. Build a fresh composition from these instructions, not the previous dense Osaka poster.

references.role: Takopen identity only; no previous poster or city image reused as reference

direction: Soft plush mascot in pastel miniature Osaka; replace the visual concept and simplify the homepage framing.
scope: Homepage hero illustration and alternative text, removal of large overlay label, softer headline and buttons, full image aspect ratio on mobile.
